O texto do prompt base não é reproduzido no artigo; o artigo não descreve explicitamente se e como o código defeituoso é inserido no prompt, por isso não se registrou `contexto` para a condição base. É a linha de base a partir da qual se calcula a eficiência 'Isolated' (ganho por token).

tecnicas.observacao: Os 12 componentes (Rule ID, Rule Description, Rule Details, Error Messages, Rule Background, Linter Message, Fix Examples, ESLint URL, Rule Source link, Test Source link, Code Block, Node Type) são informação do relatório de análise estática fornecida ao modelo num único passo, sem retorno iterativo, por isso `contexto` e não `feedback`. `exemplos` está presente só na condição Fix Examples (padrões de reparo específicos); nas demais 11 condições os mecanismos são `instrucao` e `contexto`, e o acrescentado é só `contexto`. Contrafactual: cada condição com um componente contra a condição No Information, mantido o restante do prompt (ingrediente). O estudo não detalha o conteúdo de cada componente: afirma que «Each component is summarized in Table I», mas a Tabela I traz apenas nomes, tokens médios e resultados.

citacoes.trecho: This paper presents an empirical analysis of 12 ESLint information components’ impact on GPT-4 Turbo’s repair performance.
We measure the repair performance (CodeBLEU) of each of the 12 information components when used alone in the prompt across all 10,504 test cases.
citacoes.localizador: p. 3 (impressa 819), seção III.D, Experiments for RQ1, item 1

citacoes.trecho: We measure the change in performance when a single component is removed from a full prompt containing all 12 components.
citacoes.localizador: p. 3 (impressa 819), seção III.D, Experiments for RQ2, item 1

citacoes.trecho: We compare the actual performance of a combination of the best individual components (naive optimal combination) against a combination of components predicted to have the highest synergy (synergy-based combination) to validate our synergy analysis.
citacoes.localizador: p. 3 (impressa 819), seção III.D, Experiments for RQ2, item 3

citacoes.trecho: All experiments were conducted in a zero-shot setting without any additional fine-tuning.
It was followed by Rule Description (0.5013) and Fix Examples (0.4997), indicating that both general explanations and specific repair patterns contribute to performance.
The ’High-Synergy Pair’ combining Fix Examples with Code Block achieved 0.5279, reaching 99.5% of the full 12-component performance (0.5305) while using substantially fewer tokens.
While CodeBLEU provides comprehensive syntactic and structural assessment, we acknowledge it does not measure actual executability or test-passing rates.
Third, beyond syntactic similarity, future research should integrate test-based validation to ensure repairs actually fix the underlying issues.

This leads to three critical problems: inefficiency (full ESLint reports average 2,300 tokens, potentially incurring substantial API costs at scale), information overload (prior work shows excessive information can degrade LLM performance in certain scenarios [11]), and missed optimization opportunities through ’information toxicity,’ where useful components degrade performance when combined.
Each experiment was repeated 3 times with different random seeds to account for GPT-4’s stochastic generation.
The dataset is divided into training and test sets, with our experiments conducted on the complete test set of 10,504 cases to ensure comprehensive evaluation without sampling bias.
Our experiments were conducted on GPT-4 Turbo with JavaScript code from the TFix dataset, focusing on ESLint violations.
The generalizability to other contexts requires further validation.
This requires 12 additional API calls per test case (one for each ablation), totaling 126,048 calls for the complete test dataset.
citacoes.localizador: p. 3 (impressa 819), seção III.D, Experiments for RQ2, item 1

citacoes.trecho: While useful in isolation (ranked 2nd), it showed minimal impact when removed from the full context (ranked 12th in ablation importance), with ablation score (0.5282) nearly identical to the full-information baseline (0.5260).

The ’Naive Optimal’ strategy, combining the top two isolated components—Linter Message and Rule Description—achieved a CodeBLEU score of 0.5003, which is 0.005 lower than Linter Message alone (0.5053).
(3) Strategic component selection based on interaction analysis can achieve comparable performance to using all components while reducing token usage.
